rows.grounds: instrumental dual of the pair upadeśa (direct instruction) and atideśa (extension by analogy)
relative pronoun with past passive participle
refers to the word-path and related paths
name of the scripture, the Hṛdayeśvara

items.question: How is the earlier teaching on words and related paths reapplied in the Hṛdayeśvara scripture?
premises: What was taught by direct instruction and by extension is taken up again.
This reapplication concerns the word-path and the other paths.
The reapplication is made in that very scripture, the Hṛdayeśvara.
items.inference: The Hṛdayeśvara scripture reapplies, by instruction and extension, the earlier teaching about the word-path and related paths.
uncertainties: The exact scope of 'ādi' in tatpadādiṣu (which paths besides pada) is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: What was taught earlier by direct instruction and by extension regarding the word-path and the rest is again extended in that very scripture, our Hṛdayeśvara.

rows.grounds: the paths of pada, mantra, kalā, etc.
in accordance with the previous sūtra
the state of being a triad
by the method already stated for the tattva and varṇa paths

items.question: How should the threefold division be applied to the word, mantra, and phase paths?
premises: The paths of word, mantra, phase, and so on are under consideration.
The earlier rule provides the guiding procedure.
The method already taught for the principle and letter paths supplies the model.
items.inference: Following the earlier rule, one should make the word, mantra, and phase paths threefold by the same method taught for the principle and letter paths.
uncertainties: The precise content of the 'earlier rule' (pūrvasūtra) is not restated here.
items.plain_english: Following the earlier rule, one should make the paths of word, mantra, phase, and so on threefold, using the same method that was taught for the paths of principle and letter.

rows.grounds: in the mantras of the word-path

items.question: How are the divisions determined in the word-mantras and in the phases?
premises: The determination concerns the word-mantras and the phases.
Specific numerical groupings are given: four, six and four, twenty-two, and twelve.
These numbers define how the divisions are to be understood.
items.inference: The divisions in the word-mantras and phases are determined by the stated numerical groupings of four, six and four, twenty-two, and twelve.
uncertainties: The exact mapping of each number to a specific subdivision is compressed and not fully explicit in this verse.
items.plain_english: What was said is now determined for the word-mantras and for the phases: in four, in six and four, in twenty-two, and in twelve.

rows.grounds: the four kalās starting with Nivṛtti
twelve units of an aṅgula each

items.question: Which phases are pervading and how is the second phase subdivided?
premises: The four phases beginning with Nivṛtti are identified as pervading.
Śāntyatītā is named as a distinct phase.
In the second phase, a subdivision of twelve units of twelve finger-measures is prescribed.
items.inference: The four phases beginning with Nivṛtti pervade, Śāntyatītā is included, and the second phase is subdivided into twelve units of twelve finger-measures.
uncertainties: The ritual or spatial application of the twelve-by-twelve finger-measures is not explained in this verse.
items.plain_english: The four phases beginning with Nivṛtti are pervading, and Śāntyatītā is also included. In the second phase, however, one should set out twelve divisions of twelve finger-measures.

rows.grounds: having the nature of higher, lower, and higher
by the expression that begins with the four-egg procedure

items.question: How is the twofold rule of higher-lower-higher nature indicated in this context?
premises: A twofold rule is projected in sequence.
That rule has the nature of higher, lower, and higher.
The text signals it by the expression beginning with the four-egg procedure.
items.inference: By sequential projection, the twofold rule of higher-lower-higher nature is understood here through the expression beginning with the four-egg procedure.
uncertainties: The technical referent of 'four-egg procedure' (caturaṇḍavidhi) is not explained in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having cast it out in order, the twofold rule whose nature is higher, lower, and higher is understood here by the expression that begins with the four-egg procedure.

rows.grounds: by means of the fourfold phase structure
to be declared in that context
on the body of the disciple who is to be purified

items.question: What must be established first on the disciple's body using the four-phase structure?
premises: The fourfold phase structure provides the operative framework.
A threefold rule is to be stated in that framework.
The sixfold path is to be applied on the body of the disciple to be purified.
items.inference: Using the fourfold phase structure, the threefold rule is to be applied and the sixfold path is first installed on the body of the disciple to be purified.
uncertainties: The verse compresses the procedural steps; the exact sequence of installation is not fully detailed.
items.plain_english: By means of the fourfold phase structure, the threefold rule is to be applied there. Thus, the sixfold path should first be installed on the body of the disciple who is to be purified.

rows.grounds: after installing one as primary, install what is approved as the purifier
the multitude of mantras used in installing the paths

items.question: How should the purifying mantra-stream be installed at the beginning of the path installation?
premises: One element is first installed as primary.
Then the form approved as purifier is installed.
The stream of mantras for path installation functions as a single purifier from the beginning.
items.inference: At the outset, after making one installation primary, the approved purifying stream of path-installation mantras should be installed as a single purifier.
uncertainties: The verse is metrically compressed; the exact identity of the 'one' made primary is not specified.
items.plain_english: Having installed one as primary, one should then install what is approved as the purifier. From the beginning, the stream of mantras for installing the paths is indeed a single purifier.

rows.grounds: Mālinī as the totality of sound
taken as whole and as divided

items.question: In what ways is the Mālinī, the totality of sound, divided?
premises: Mālinī is identified as the mass of sound.
It can be taken as collected and as separated, giving a twofold division.
Alternatively, as a single heroic power or through paired union, it forms a sixfold grouping.
items.inference: Mālinī is divided twofold as collected and separated, and alternatively appears as a sixfold grouping through single-hero or paired-union modes.
uncertainties: The precise referents of the sixfold grouping are not enumerated in this verse.
items.plain_english: Mālinī, the mass of sound, is twofold as collected and separated. Or else, by its single-hero state or through paired union, it is taken as a sixfold group.

rows.grounds: sixfold through distinctions of śakti and corresponding forms
by being single and by being paired

items.question: How does the five-faced form become twelvefold?
premises: The five-faced form is divided sixfold by distinctions of power and corresponding forms.
That sixfold division is further divided twofold as single and paired.
The resulting total is twelve aspects.
items.inference: Through a sixfold division by power-distinctions and a further twofold division into single and paired modes, the five-faced form becomes twelvefold.
uncertainties: The specific identities of the six and twelve aspects are not listed in this verse.
items.plain_english: The five-faced form becomes sixfold through distinctions of power and their corresponding forms, and again twofold as single and paired; thus she becomes twelve-natured.

rows.grounds: twofold because of being complete and otherwise
again divided in the same way as the faced form

items.question: How does the six-limbed form expand into twenty-four divisions?
premises: The six-limbed form is first twofold as whole and other.
It is then divided again in the same manner as the faced form.
This process yields a multiplication resulting in twenty-four divisions.
items.inference: By a twofold division and a further division like the faced form, the six-limbed form is multiplied into twenty-four divisions.
uncertainties: The intermediate steps of the multiplication are compressed and not fully spelled out.
items.plain_english: The six-limbed form is twofold as whole and other, and again divided like the faced form; multiplied in that way, it becomes twenty-fourfold.

rows.grounds: in the octad starting with Aghora
the mantra of the true being of the Mothers

items.question: What divisions arise in the Aghora-octad and what is the status of the Mothers' mantra?
premises: In the octad beginning with Aghora there are two divisions and a third.
The third arises from the rise of the paired (yāmala) mode.
The mantra of the true being of the Mothers stands alone and belongs to the śruti-circle.
items.inference: The Aghora-octad yields two divisions plus a third from yāmala arising, while the Mothers' true-being mantra remains single within the śruti-circle.
uncertainties: The technical meaning of 'śruti-circle' in this ritual context is not explained here.
items.plain_english: In the group of eight beginning with Aghora there are two divisions and a third arising from the paired mode. And the mantra of the true being of the Mothers stands alone, belonging to the circle of hearing.

in the mode of a single heroic power

items.question: How does the same purifier come to be counted as thirteenfold and fourteenfold?
premises: Divisions of one, two, three, and four yield a thirteenfold form.
The same entity is also considered in the mode of a single heroic power.
In that mode it is established as fourteenfold.
items.inference: The same purifier is thirteenfold by the divisions of one, two, three, and four, and becomes fourteenfold when taken in the single-hero mode.
uncertainties: The exact accounting that produces thirteen and then fourteen is not fully itemized in this verse.
items.plain_english: By divisions of one, two, three, and four it is thirteenfold; and this same one, taken in the single-hero mode, stands as fourteenfold.
